description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Make More, Keep More press conference in Shelby alongside Congressman Tim Moore, NC Senator Ted Alexander, and NC Rep Paul Scott where they highlighted how Cooper’s far-left policies made life more expensive for North Carolina families. Under Cooper’s watch energy costs skyrocketed 30%, housing costs went up by 85%, and healthcare costs rose to the highest in the country. Congressman Moore, Senator Alexander, and Representative Scott joined Whatley to address how Roy Cooper raised costs on families and businesses across North Carolina.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Hosts Make More, Keep More Press Conference in Shelby – Michael Whatley for Senate
